newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GOULD CALLS UP THREE CARDIFF PLAYERS FOR DUTCH MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOULD CALLS UP THREE CARDIFF PLAYERS FOR DUTCH MATCH.

text.p: Wales manager Bobby Gould called up Cardiff trio Lee Jarman, Scott Young and Patrick Mountain into his senior squad on Monday for Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Holland in Cardiff.
The trio, all uncapped at senior level, had been named in the Under-21 squad for Friday's clash with Holland at Ninian Park.
Defender Jarman, 18, and striker Young, 20, have both won two Under-21 caps, but 20-year-old goalkeeper Mountain is uncapped.
The trio have been elevated to the senior squad because of an injury to Blackburn defender Chris Coleman and doubts about the availability of Everton goalkeeper Neville Southall.
